name: issue-graph
title: Issue Graph
description: Search issues in your self-hosted Issue Graph and jump straight to them.
author: shdennlin

commands.name: search-issues
commands.title: Search Issues
commands.subtitle: Issue Graph
commands.description: Fuzzy-search cached issues and open them in Issue Graph or Linear.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Issue Graph URL
preferences.description: Base URL where Issue Graph is served (no trailing slash).

preferences.name: opener
preferences.title: Open Links With
preferences.description: Pick a BROWSER (e.g. Google Chrome) or leave empty for your system default. Do NOT pick the installed PWA app — launching a PWA app via macOS does not pass the deep-link URL, so the issue won't focus. To land in the PWA window, pick Chrome AND enable 'Open supported links in this app' in the PWA's settings.
